supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension beyond the lateral canthus visible as a dark horizontal shelf

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle and mental region show high-intensity (lighter) pixels contrasting sharply against low-intensity (darker) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick, protruding lower lip visible with a slight structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-reflectance white patch (potential depigmentation or scar) is visible on the lower right-hand side of the muzzle/chin area
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized white spot on the right lateral aspect of the lower lip/mental region
